# Decision index

Every recorded decision in this repository, from every store that holds one, in one file to search.
Each entry links back to its source line; **the source stays authoritative**, this file is a projection.
To record a new decision, write it in the store that fits (a durable "why" belongs in `.ai/memory/`,
see its README) and regenerate.

| Store | Holds | Entries |
|---|---|---|
| [`.ai/memory/`](../.ai/memory/README.md) | one fact per file: decisions, gotchas, failed approaches (append-only; supersede, never edit) | 4 |
| [`.ai/directions/ledger.jsonl`](../.ai/directions/ledger.jsonl) | the operator's verdict on each proposed direction, linked to its proposal | 19 |
| [`.claude/ship-loop/decisions.md`](../.claude/ship-loop/decisions.md) | checkpoint answers and auto-decisions of a /ship-loop campaign | 30 |
| [`.claude/ship-loop/archive-ai-bookkeeper/decisions.md`](../.claude/ship-loop/archive-ai-bookkeeper/decisions.md) | checkpoint answers and auto-decisions of a /ship-loop campaign | 10 |

Decisions argued only in a commit body are not indexed here; search history with
`git log --grep=<topic>`, or by session trailer with `node scripts/git/by-session.mjs`.
